# 1 Enoch Chapter 69 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** After this judgment they will be terrified and made to tremble — because of what they disclosed to those who live on earth.

**2** Here are the names of those angels: First among them is Samyaza, their leader; second, Araqiel; third, Armen; fourth, Kokabiel; fifth, Turiel; sixth, Rumiel; seventh, Danial; eighth, Nuqiel; ninth, Baraqiel; tenth, Azazel; eleventh, Armaros; twelfth, Batariel; thirteenth, Ananel; fourteenth, Turiel; fifteenth, Amsiel; sixteenth, Araqiel; seventeenth, Basasiel; eighteenth, Ananel; and their head, Samiazaz.

**3** Those are the names of the angels, and these are their chiefs.

**4** Then there is Gadreel — he is the one who taught humanity every kind of lethal blow. He it was who led Eve astray, and who taught the sons of men the instruments of death: the shield, the body-armor, the sword for combat, and every weapon of death that comes against human beings.

**5** From his hand these things have spread against all who live on earth, from that day until forever.

**6** The second was named Penemue. He taught human beings the taste of the bitter and the sweet, and he taught them all the secrets of human wisdom.

**7** He showed humanity how to write with ink and paper — and because of this, countless people have sinned from age to age, right down to this day.

**8** Human beings were not meant for this — to seal their promises with pen and ink.

**9** For human beings were created to be exactly like the angels, meant to remain pure and righteous, and death — which unmakes everything — would never have been able to claim them. But through this knowledge they are being destroyed, and through this power it devours me.

**10** The third was named Kasdeja. He is the one who taught humanity every kind of harmful spirit-strike and demon-strike: how to abort a pregnancy in the womb, how to wound the soul — the serpent's bite, and the strikes that come through the scorching noonday sun — through the serpent's offspring named Tabaat.

**11** Now this is the work of Kasbeel, the chief of the oath, who revealed it to the holy ones when he lived high above in glory. Its name is Biqa.

**12** This angel pleaded with Michael to reveal the hidden name to him, so that he could pronounce it in an oath — so that those who disclosed all the hidden things to human beings would shake with terror before that name and that oath.

**13** This is the power of this oath: it is mighty and strong. He placed this oath — Akae — into Michael's hands.

**14** These are the secrets of this oath, and through his oath they are held firm: heaven was suspended before the world was created, and will remain so forever.

**15** Through it, the earth was established on the water; and from hidden recesses within the mountains beautiful waters have flowed since the world was made, and will flow forever.

**16** Through that oath the sea was created; and to restrain it in its rage, he set sand as its boundary — the sea has never crossed that line from the day of creation until forever.

**17** Through that oath the depths are held firm; they stand still and do not shift from their place, from age to age.

**18** Through that oath the sun and moon complete their circuits; they do not deviate from their appointed course, from age to age.

**19** Through that oath the stars follow their courses; he calls each of them by name, and they answer him, from age to age.

**20** And so too the spirits of the waters, the winds, every breeze — their paths from all corners of the winds.

**21** The sounds of thunder and the blazing of lightning are held in reserve; the storerooms of hail, the storerooms of frost, the storerooms of mist, and the storerooms of rain and dew are all kept in their places.

**22** All of these trust and give thanks before the Lord of Spirits; they glorify him with every power they have. Their sustenance is in every act of praise: they thank and glorify and extol the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.

**23** This oath holds power over all of them; through it their paths are maintained and their course does not break down.

**24** There was tremendous joy among them. They blessed and glorified and exalted, because the name of that Son of Man had been revealed to them.

**25** And he sat on his throne of glory. The full authority of judgment was placed in the hands of the Son of Man. He caused the sinners to pass away and be wiped off the face of the earth; those who led the world astray were bound with chains, imprisoned in the place made for their destruction, and all their works vanished from the face of the earth.

**26** From that moment on, nothing corruptible will remain. For that Son of Man has appeared and taken his seat on the throne of his glory, and all evil will dissolve before his face, and the word of that Son of Man will go out and carry power before the Lord of Spirits.

**27** This is the Third Parable of Enoch.

**28** Blessed are you, people of God — the ancestral fathers of Enoch's line, you who keep the righteous in memory.

**29** Blessed are you, people of righteousness — for you will know everything in its fullness, forever.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 69 is the most encyclopedic chapter in the Parables. The angelic name list (vv. 1-3) is the Parables' version of the Watcher roll-call. Gadreel's role in the Eden story (v. 4) provides an alternate Gen 3 tradition where the tempter is a named fallen angel rather than an anonymous serpent. Penemue's teaching of writing (v. 7) is one of the most striking passages in all of 1 Enoch — literacy itself is presented as a dangerous forbidden gift. The cosmic-oath cosmology (vv. 14-23) is unique in Second Temple literature.*
